# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sagargupta16/orrery/main/skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json # Figure analytics-boundaries from .claude/orrery/plan.json (decisions.md 2026-10-22 applied). # Shown in docs/architecture.md and docs/CALCULATIONS.md at 880 px. title: "Where the numbers come from: rollups, on-demand SQL, client calculations" subtitle: Rollup tables the analytics engine publishes, on-demand SQL aggregates, the full ledger and lib/finance in the browser direction: down # No layout.aspect: 4:3 turned the flow into a 1749 px strip (labels at 6.5 px at 880 wide); # top to bottom (browser, API, database) fits the 880 px column at full size.
legend: dashed: Explicit retry only
layout: { spacing: loose, layering: simplex } groups: fe: type: zone label: Browser (SPA) icon: tabler:browser evidence: frontend/src/hooks/api/useTransactions.ts:16 be: type: box label: FastAPI on Vercel icon: logos:fastapi-icon evidence: backend/api/index.py:3 store: type: box label: Neon PostgreSQL icon: logos:neon-icon # Pooler URL normalization; PgBouncer pooler per the repo CLAUDE.md Deployment section. evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/db/session.py:39
nodes: pages: icon: tabler:layout-dashboard # The 25 lazy pages include Upload, Transactions and Settings, not only analytics. label: Workspace pages note: 25 lazy pages in: fe evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx:59-83 hooks: icon: logos:react-query-icon label: TanStack Query hooks in: fe evidence: - frontend/src/hooks/api/useAnalyticsV2.ts - frontend/src/hooks/api/useCalculations.ts - frontend/src/hooks/api/useTransactions.ts:16 finance: icon: tabler:calculator label: lib/finance calculators note: "tax, net worth, returns" in: fe evidence: - frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:27 - frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:17 v2: icon: tabler:api label: Analytics v2 API note: rollup reads in: be evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:30 calc: icon: tabler:sql label: Calculations API note: "on-demand SQL, rollup fast path" in: be evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations.py:27-301 upload: icon: tabler:upload label: Upload service in: be evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:14 engine: icon: tabler:refresh label: Analytics engine note: "versioned, dirty dates" in: be evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/engine.py:104-287 - backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/refresh.py:96-181 txapi: icon: tabler:list-details label: Transactions API in: be evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/transactions.py:137-138 rollups: shape: cylinder label: Rollup tables note: "daily, monthly, FY, trends" in: store evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/db/_models/analytics.py:30-380 txns: shape: cylinder label: transactions in: store evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/db/_models/transactions.py:57-60
edges: - pages -> hooks: { label: query, evidence: frontend/src/hooks/api/useTransactions.ts:16 } - pages -> finance: label: compute client-side evidence: - frontend/src/pages/tax-planning/useTaxPlanning.ts:27#computeAnnualTaxPlanning - frontend/src/pages/net-worth/useNetWorth.ts:17 - hooks -> v2: label: "GET /api/analytics/v2/*, POST refresh" evidence: - frontend/src/services/api/analyticsV2Summaries.ts:181-215 - frontend/src/services/api/upload.ts:63 - hooks -> calc: { label: "GET /api/calculations/*", evidence: frontend/src/services/api/calculations.ts:149-206 } - hooks -> txapi: { label: "GET /api/transactions/all", evidence: frontend/src/services/api/transactions.ts:77 } - hooks -> upload: label: POST /api/upload evidence: - frontend/src/services/api/upload.ts:52 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/upload.py:80 - v2 -> rollups: { label: read, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:17-27 } # Data health and the 50/30/20 spending rule query transactions directly. - v2 -> txns: label: "data health, spending rule" evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2_impl/summaries_health.py:139 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2_impl/spending_rule.py:262-271 - calc -> txns: label: aggregate evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/calculation_service.py:20 - backend/src/ledger_sync/services/calculation_service.py:62-105 # Unfiltered totals, monthly aggregation and category breakdown read monthly_summaries / category_trends. - calc -> rollups: label: unfiltered fast path evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations_impl/aggregates.py:59-70 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations_impl/aggregates.py:106-111 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/calculations_impl/categories.py:92-99 - txapi -> txns: { label: full ledger, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/api/transactions.py:137-139 } - upload -> txns: { label: import rows, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:24 } # upload_service.py:33 calls AnalyticsEngine(...).refresh_analytics() after the import commits. - upload -> engine: { label: after commit, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/services/upload_service.py:33 } # POST /api/analytics/v2/refresh; the frontend calls it only for an explicit retry (repo CLAUDE.md, Upload pipeline). - v2 -> engine: label: POST refresh line: dashed evidence: - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:26 - backend/src/ledger_sync/api/analytics_v2.py:46 - engine -> txns: { label: read ledger, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/engine.py:104-129 } - engine -> rollups: { label: publish, evidence: backend/src/ledger_sync/core/analytics/engine.py:287#publish_refresh }

svg.title: Where the numbers come from: rollups, on-demand SQL, client calculations
svg.desc: Where the numbers come from: rollups, on-demand SQL, client calculations. 10 components in 3 groups. Connections: Workspace pages to TanStack Query hooks (query); Workspace pages to lib/finance calculators (compute client-side); TanStack Query hooks to Analytics v2 API (GET /api/analytics/v2/*, POST refresh); TanStack Query hooks to Calculations API (GET /api/calculations/*); TanStack Query hooks to Transactions API (GET /api/transactions/all); TanStack Query hooks to Upload service (POST /api/upload); Analytics v2 API to Rollup tables (read); Analytics v2 API to transactions (data health, spending rule); Calculations API to transactions (aggregate); Calculations API to Rollup tables (unfiltered fast path); Transactions API to transactions (full ledger); Upload service to transactions (import rows); Upload service to Analytics engine (after commit); Analytics v2 API to Analytics engine (POST refresh); Analytics engine to transactions (read ledger); Analytics engine to Rollup tables (publish).

text.tspan: WHERE THE NUMBERS COME FROM: ROLLUPS, ON-DEMAND SQL, CLIENT CALCULATIONS
Rollup tables the analytics engine publishes, on-demand SQL aggregates, the full ledger and lib/finance in the browser
